statements.label: Theorem 1
statements.restatement: For the cost qf2+pf9+jf1+cf45+ef5+df35+bf0+af7 with d=1, p,b,j,e>0, all coefficients >=0, and 0<L<=min(p,b): if c >= min_x max{K(1-x)^2-1, Bx^2}, K=1/j+1/(L+1), B=max{1/e+1/(L+1),1/L} (equivalently sqrt((c+1)/K)+sqrt(c/B) >= 1), then Phi_c(O) >= 0 for every O in SO(4). Pointwise coefficient statement: no spectral hypothesis, so it covers all spectra. General d>0 by scaling.
